_doc: Integration milestones. state: done | wip | todo. A milestone is done only when its test passes; 'test' says what that is.

items.name: Build inventory
items.test: s30/docs/01-inventory.md lists every binary, pak family and tool with versions

items.name: Dependency map
items.test: s30/docs/02-architecture.md: injection, bridge, dedi, assets

items.name: Signature census
items.test: pattern_census.py run on S21 DX11/DX12, S3 dedi, S30

items.name: String/param diff
items.test: strings_diff.py: netmsg, convar, launch-param, script-native families

items.name: S30 netmsg ID map
items.test: every S21 msgArray slot matched to an S30 slot (GetType + RFB body)
items.note: s30/docs/11: 52 S21 S2C slots and 29 C2S slots matched (order+size, handler slot, decompiled bodies); format changes: svc_Print +1 bit, clc_ClientTick 3 values; clc_Move usercmd encoding still to compare

items.name: Recv table diff
items.test: S30 client class/recvprop dump diffed against S21
items.note: client logs every S3 SendProp without an S30 RecvProp or with another type; type changes found (weapon mod bitfields, consumable counts, class mods, overheat) -> prop adapters in progress (docs/20)

items.name: Script native diff
items.test: S30 native registration table dumped; Flowstate client/UI calls checked

items.name: Asset version census
items.test: per-type asset versions of S30 paks vs what the S3 dedi parses

items.name: Connect/signon trace
items.test: S30 connectionless packets and signon sequence documented
items.note: s30/docs/12: connectionless packets, CONNACCEPT hand-over, signon rungs CONNECTED..FULL, DataBlock, all documented and run

items.name: Integrity checks
items.test: S30 code-integrity / import checks found or ruled out
items.note: no integrity reaction to an added import + 7 .text patches over a 75 s run; longer sessions untested

items.name: Loader injects
items.test: patched S30 copy loads loader.dll -> client_s30.dll; S30_EarlyInit and SDK_Init both log
items.note: loader.dll (S30 image table, LauncherMain 0x588C50) loads client_s30.dll; early init + SDK_Init both run (docs/06)

items.name: Offline + net guard
items.test: no non-loopback connection during boot (guard log + netstat)
items.note: guard refuses all non-loopback traffic from DllMain on; EA app spawn refused; Origin offline patches D/E/A1/A2/C/F/P applied; client stays up

items.name: Core detours
items.test: tier0/tier1/convar/cmd/filesystem resolve and attach on S30
items.note: engine log, Cbuf, script print, ICvar + ConCommand registration verified on S30 (docs/07, docs/08); filesystem/pak hooks not yet

items.name: Main menu
items.test: client reaches the main menu with SDK console
items.note: S30 title/main menu: ImGui SDK overlay (console/status/connect), engine-registered SDK commands, offline + guarded (docs/08)

items.name: Script VM hooks
items.test: client/UI VMs compile Flowstate scripts without errors

items.name: Bridge symbols
items.test: every NetObs symbol resolves and is verified on S30

items.name: Challenge/connect
items.test: dedi logs the S30 client as connected
items.note: bridge_connect: C2S_CHALLENGE -> S2C_CHALLENGE -> C2S_CONNECT -> CONNACCEPT; dedi logs the client, signon 2 -> 3 (docs/09)

items.name: Signon complete
items.test: client reaches SIGNONSTATE_FULL

items.name: First snapshot
items.test: client decodes snapshots without desync
items.note: S3 snapshots re-encoded to S30 50, full + deltas acked, no desync over 5-minute sessions (docs/12 step 6)

items.name: Entities replicate
items.test: player, weapons, props created and moving
items.note: player spawns and moves, a given R-99 renders and fires, impacts arrive; weapon mod bitfields and some props do not bind yet (B2)

items.name: Script remotes
items.test: S2C/C2S ScriptRemote calls run on both ends
items.note: S2C calls run on the CLIENT/UI VMs against the S30 registrations; client calls reach the dedi by name and run (docs/12 steps 9-10, docs/15)

items.name: 10-min session
items.test: 10 minutes in game, no kick, no crash

items.name: Disconnect/rejoin
items.test: disconnect and reconnect cleanly
items.note: known: a disconnect while assets still stream in crashes the client (engine asset-loader lookup, docs/13)

items.name: Server closure
items.test: list of S30 assets the dedi must load for the target content
items.note: dedi_paks.py closure: the S30 assets the dedi loads for the staging map and mp_lobby (docs/10)

items.name: Models -> dedi
items.test: converted mdl load on the dedi (sample, then batch)
items.note: 3300 S30 models converted for the dedi; collision gate dedi_coll_gate.py passes on all (docs/10)

items.name: Anims -> dedi
items.test: arig/aseq convert with R5-AnimConv -i 30 -o 3, clips play

items.name: BSP -> dedi
items.test: bspconv -dedi output loads, collision matches
items.note: staging map and mp_lobby BSPs from S30 load on the dedi and reach ready; dedi_bsp_gate.py (docs/10, docs/17)

items.name: Dedi paks + VPK
items.test: RePak/revpk outputs load with zero missing-asset errors
items.note: dedi rpaks + VPKs rebuilt from S30 under the same names; ready with 0 unresolved dependencies (docs/10)

items.name: Launch scripts
items.test: one command starts dedi + S30 client from the workspace
items.note: setup_s3_server.ps1 + start_s3_server.ps1 + deploy_s30_client.ps1; no single combined launcher yet
